protocol.dataset: COCO 2017 train split, fixed image-disjoint holdout
protocol.fixed_click_policy: One frozen-baseline-derived sequence per instance, shared by all modes, epochs, and seeds

viewport_modes.shuffled: no-self instance permutation of complete synthetic trajectories
viewport_modes.correct: GT-instance-bbox oracle from round 2 onward; not real user telemetry

viewport_signal_criterion.definition: Both paired mIoU@5 means >= +0.01 and both contrasts positive for every seed
viewport_signal_criterion.verdict: inconclusive: independent viewport information not established
